credit_ledger_type_amount_check.name: credit_ledger_type_amount_check
credit_ledger_type_amount_check.value:
(
        ("credit_ledger"."type" IN ('purchase', 'refund') AND "credit_ledger"."amount" > 0)
        OR ("credit_ledger"."type" = 'processing_deduction' AND "credit_ledger"."amount" < 0)
        OR "credit_ledger"."type" IN ('manual_adjustment', 'expiration_adjustment')
      )

credit_ledger_reference_check.name: credit_ledger_reference_check
credit_ledger_reference_check.value:
(
        ("credit_ledger"."type" = 'purchase' AND "credit_ledger"."stripe_payment_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR (
          "credit_ledger"."type" IN ('processing_deduction', 'refund')
          AND "credit_ledger"."project_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "credit_ledger"."processing_job_id" IS NOT NULL
        )
        OR "credit_ledger"."type" IN ('manual_adjustment', 'expiration_adjustment')
      )

processing_failure_intents_lease_check.name: processing_failure_intents_lease_check
processing_failure_intents_lease_check.value:
(
        (
          "processing_failure_intents"."lease_token" IS NULL
          AND "processing_failure_intents"."lease_owner" IS NULL
          AND "processing_failure_intents"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR (
          "processing_failure_intents"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL
          AND "processing_failure_intents"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL
          AND "processing_failure_intents"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
        )
      )

processing_failure_intents_finalized_che.name: processing_failure_intents_finalized_check
processing_failure_intents_finalized_che.value:
(
        ("processing_failure_intents"."status" = 'pending' AND "processing_failure_intents"."finalized_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("processing_failure_intents"."status" = 'finalized' AND "processing_failure_intents"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL)
      )

processing_job_dispatches_lease_check.name: processing_job_dispatches_lease_check
processing_job_dispatches_lease_check.value:
(
        ("processing_job_dispatches"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "processing_job_dispatches"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "processing_job_dispatches"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL)
        OR (
          "processing_job_dispatches"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL
          AND "processing_job_dispatches"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL
          AND "processing_job_dispatches"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
        )
      )

processing_job_dispatches_published_chec.name: processing_job_dispatches_published_check
processing_job_dispatches_published_chec.value:
(
        ("processing_job_dispatches"."status" = 'pending' AND "processing_job_dispatches"."published_at" IS NULL)
        OR (
          "processing_job_dispatches"."status" = 'published'
          AND "processing_job_dispatches"."published_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "processing_job_dispatches"."bullmq_job_id" IS NOT NULL
        )
      )

processing_jobs_execution_lease_check.name: processing_jobs_execution_lease_check
processing_jobs_execution_lease_check.value:
(
        (
          "processing_jobs"."execution_lease_token" IS NULL
          AND "processing_jobs"."execution_lease_owner" IS NULL
          AND "processing_jobs"."execution_lease_expires_at" IS NULL
          AND "processing_jobs"."execution_heartbeat_at" IS NULL
        )
        OR (
          "processing_jobs"."execution_lease_token" IS NOT NULL
          AND "processing_jobs"."execution_lease_owner" IS NOT NULL
          AND "processing_jobs"."execution_lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "processing_jobs"."execution_heartbeat_at" IS NOT NULL
        )
      )

stripe_checkout_sessions_binding_check.name: stripe_checkout_sessions_binding_check
stripe_checkout_sessions_binding_check.value:
(
        ("stripe_checkout_sessions"."status" IN ('creating', 'failed') AND "stripe_checkout_sessions"."stripe_session_id" IS NULL)
        OR (
          "stripe_checkout_sessions"."status" IN ('open', 'completed', 'expired')
          AND "stripe_checkout_sessions"."stripe_session_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "stripe_checkout_sessions"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL
        )
      )
